description: This file 'CheckDeletable.php' in the 'EmailTemplates' module of SuiteCRM is responsible for handling requests to determine if an email template can be deleted. It checks if the template is in use or referenced in system settings and returns a boolean or list of in-use templates accordingly.

methods.name: check_email_template_in_use
methods.description: Determines if an email template is currently in use either by email marketing or system password templates.
